description:
## [1.6.0](https://github.com/Darkaxt/morphe-patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-11-23)

### ✨ New Features

* **thelonging:** replace global CanvasScaler patch with 4 targeted 4:3/foldable patches ([dc23ff3](https://github.com/Darkaxt/morphe-patches/commit/dc23ff3d4b2827a02aa1189709e79bbcc766859f))

patches.name: Endless Fall & 3-Lives
patches.description: Replaces instant fall-death with continuous falling onto previous platforms with live score reduction, adds a 3-lives HUD system with balanced fall damage and monster/UFO damage with brief invulnerability, and tracks Peak Score. Black Holes remain instant Game Over.

patches.name: Foldable Seamless Wide View
patches.description: Zooms out wide/unfolded screens (such as Galaxy Z Fold / 4:3 tablets) to full tall portrait vertical visibility (~600 logical height), centers UI cleanly without 4:3 overlap, remaps touch input, and fills the side margins with seamless cylindrical wrap-around rendering of the playfield.

patches.name: Fix 4:3 / Foldable Book & Drawing UI Scaling
patches.description: Scales the Book, Thoughts, Book Shelf, and Drawing overlays to 0.75x on narrow (< 1.4) aspect ratios instead of 1.05x so menus fit cleanly inside the full-screen 4:3 stone HUD border without shrinking the game into a 16:9 letterbox.

patches.name: Fix 4:3 / Foldable Starting Intro Camera
patches.description: Aligns Scene 13's Intro Camera viewport to the centered 16:9 stone frame on narrow (< 1.75) aspect ratios so the starting intro animation is no longer cropped on the left and right edges.

patches.name: Fix 4:3 / Foldable Video Cutscene Scaling
patches.description: Switches VideoPlayer from FitVertically to FitInside so cutscenes, dreams, and ending videos never crop horizontally on 4:3 tablets, foldables, or ultrawides.

patches.name: Fix Foldable Live Aspect Ratio
patches.description: Removes permanent aspect-ratio caching in GetAspectRatio() so folding or unfolding mid-session immediately updates camera zoom, room borders, HUD, and UI scaling.
